newsitem.title: EU: EP Economic Committee agenda - June 9.
newsitem.headline: EP Economic Committee agenda - June 9.

text.p: Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs and Industrial Policy [[ Monday 09 June 1997 ]] EXTRAORDINARY MEETING 0. 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.591 ) 2. Chairman's announcements 3. Commercial communications in the Internal Market - Green Paper (T03907) COS0430 COM(96)0192 C4-0365/96 + ECON Fond R LARIVE Jessica E. (ELD) (PE222.182/A ) - Adoption of draft report 4. The implications of the information society for European Union policies - preparing the next steps (T05013) COS0464 COM(96)0607 C4-0648/96 + ECON Fond R BOOGERD-QUAAK Johann (ELD) (PE221.848 ) - Adoption of draft report 5. Standardization and the global information society: the European approach (T05015) COS0466 COM(96)0359 C4-0523/96 + ECON Fond R RUBIG Paul. (PPE) (PE221.849 ) - Adoption of draft report 6. Reduced rates of or exemptions from excise duty for certain mineral oils used for specific purposes (T05308) CNS96263 COM(96)0549 C4-0071/97 + ECON Fond R COX Patrick. (ELD) (PE221.264 ) - Adoption of draft report 7. Any other business 8. Dates of next meetings: - in Strasbourg on 10 June 1997: joint meeting with the Legal Affairs Committee at which Mr MONTI, Member of the Commission, will be present - in Brussels: -. Tuesday 17 June 1997, 3 - 6.30 p.m. -. Wednesday 18 June 1997, 9 a.m. - 12.30 p.m. and 3 - 6.30 p.m. and -. Thursday 19 June 1997, 9 a.m. - 12.30 p.m. - FIN - 6 END OF DOCUMENT.
